summary: Repairs the non-starting ES-module server and implements Yjs synchronization using the installed protocol APIs with testable server lifecycle.
Adds document metadata CRUD with readable creation Location, validation, optimistic rename/delete versions, persistent tombstones and active-room deletion handling.
Candidate collaborative state is persisted before live mutation and broadcast; corruption and failed writes preserve authoritative state with tested file cleanup.
Implements the documented room UI, presence, import/export, formatting, literal search/replace and sanitized preview through one controlled Yjs input path.
Fixes relayed-presence handling, room/session cleanup and deleted-room state; responsive text actions fit desktop and narrow layouts.
Nine detailed course documents, two reviewed screenshots and reproducible backend/browser gates teach CRUD, CRDTs, persistence, conflicts, testing and progressive mid-level exercises.

checks.command: npm run test:server; npm run lint; npm run build; eight Playwright Chromium scenarios; build and two layout rechecks
checks.environment: Node 22.16.0; npm 10.9.2; locked installs; Chromium 148.0.7778.96; real HTTP/WebSockets/Yjs/files and child-process startup

limits: Shared local lab with no authenticated ownership, membership revocation, database or multi-process storage coordination.
Live is synchronization status, not a per-edit disk receipt; sender-local edits can remain unaccepted after a failed write.
Synchronous full-state persistence and retained tombstones need scaling/retention design; no power-loss or network-filesystem guarantee.
No complete IME/remote-cursor binding or document history UI.
Docker scaffolding was not executed because the daemon was unavailable.
